{
  "status": "READY",

  "architecture_contract": {
    "design": {
      "name": "fc_int8_tile8",
      "version": "1.0.0",
      "description": "Buffered fully connected layer accelerator with a fixed 8x8 INT8 multiply/INT32 accumulate array, INT32 bias addition, and mandatory ReLU."
    },
    "operations": [
      {
        "name": "gemm",
        "kind": "matrix_multiply",
        "semantics": "Mandatory. For each m,n, initialize s=0 and, for k=0 through K-1, update s=wrap32(s+sign_extend32(A[m,k]*B[k,n])). Each multiplication is an exact signed 8x8-to-16-bit multiplication. Produce S[m,n]=s.",
        "inputs": ["A", "B"],
        "outputs": ["S"]
      },
      {
        "name": "bias_add",
        "kind": "broadcast_add",
        "semantics": "Mandatory after gemm for each element. D[m,n]=wrap32(S[m,n]+bias[n]). Bias is broadcast across rows.",
        "inputs": ["S", "bias"],
        "outputs": ["D"]
      },
      {
        "name": "relu",
        "kind": "activation",
        "semantics": "Mandatory after bias_add. Interpret D as signed INT32; Y[m,n]=0 if D[m,n]<0, otherwise Y[m,n]=D[m,n]. No output quantization.",
        "inputs": ["D"],
        "outputs": ["Y"]
      }
    ],
    "data_types": [
      {
        "name": "int8",
        "role": "Activation and weight elements",
        "width_bits": 8,
        "signed": true,
        "representation": "Two's-complement integer.",
        "conversion_semantics": "Input payload bits [7:0] are reinterpreted as signed INT8; bits [31:8] are ignored.",
        "overflow_semantics": "All 256 input bit patterns are legal.",
        "rounding_semantics": "None."
      },
      {
        "name": "int16_product",
        "role": "Internal multiplier result",
        "width_bits": 16,
        "signed": true,
        "representation": "Two's-complement integer.",
        "conversion_semantics": "Exact signed INT8 multiplication; sign-extend to 32 bits before accumulation.",
        "overflow_semantics": "Every INT8 product fits exactly.",
        "rounding_semantics": "None."
      },
      {
        "name": "int32",
        "role": "Accumulator, bias, biased intermediate, and output elements",
        "width_bits": 32,
        "signed": true,
        "representation": "Two's-complement integer.",
        "conversion_semantics": "Bias payload uses all 32 bits unchanged. Output uses the 32-bit ReLU result unchanged.",
        "overflow_semantics": "wrap32 retains the low 32 bits of mathematical addition and reinterprets them as signed. Applies independently to every accumulation and bias addition; no saturation.",
        "rounding_semantics": "None."
      }
    ],
    "data_objects": [
      {
        "name": "A",
        "role": "Activation matrix",
        "data_type": "int8",
        "dimensions": ["M", "K"],
        "producer": "external",

        "external": true
      },
      {
        "name": "B",
        "role": "Weight matrix",
        "data_type": "int8",
        "dimensions": ["K", "N"],
        "producer": "external",
        "consumers": ["gemm"],
        "external": true
      },
      {
        "name": "bias",

        "dimensions": ["N"],
        "producer": "external",
        "consumers": ["bias_add"],
        "external": true
      },

        "name": "S",

        "external": false

        "name": "Y",

        "data_type": "int32",
        "dimensions": ["M", "N"],

        "consumers": ["external"],
        "external": true

        "bound_parameter": "MAX_M"

    "control": {

      "state_progression": "IDLE accepts a command. A legal command enters LOAD_A, then LOAD_B, LOAD_BIAS, INIT, MAC, EMIT. A nonfinal tile's last output enters INIT for the next tile. The job's final output enters IDLE and pulses done. An illegal command remains in IDLE and pulses error.",

    "latency_model": "Let L=M*K+K*N+N, T=ceil(M/8)*ceil(N/8), and V_t=R_t*C_t. Exactly L scalar input transfers prepare the job; no compute occurs during these loading cycles. All sixteen operands for each MAC step come from sixteen independent bank reads; no operand-staging cycles are hidden. done is high during the cycle immediately following final output acceptance.   "interface_contract": {
    "protocol": "Single-clock custom ready-valid command, scalar input, and scalar output channels; busy/done/error status.",
    "clock": "clk; all transfers and state updates occur on rising edges.",
    "reset": "rst, synchronous active high. While high, suppress cmd_ready, in_ready, out_valid, busy, out_last, done, and error. A rising edge with rst asserted aborts the job and restores IDLE.",
    "channels": [

        "framing": "Exactly one command transfer per attempted job. Dimensions are separate simultaneous fields, not packed into in_data. Legal commands are followed by one operand frame.",

Section boundaries are determined solely by accepted-beat counts; no header, last, padding, or partial-vector beat exists.",
        "ordering": "A section, then B section, then bias section; exactly M*K+K*N+N accepted beats per legal job.",
        "backpressure": "in_ready is high exactly in LOAD_A, LOAD_B, or LOAD_BIAS while !rst. Producer retains the full in_data payload and in_valid while stalled. The first operand can transfer no earlier than the edge after command acceptance."

        "metadata": ["out_last marks the final result beat of the job"],

        "ordering": "Tile-row-major traversal with local row-major emission. Output coordinates are implicit from the accepted command and beat order.",
        "backpressure": "out_valid is high exactly in EMIT while !rst. Hold out_data, out_last, and out_valid until out_ready accepts the beat."

        "backpressure": "No acknowledgement or backpressure; consumers must observe event cycles."
      }
    ],
